title: Markdown Explorer
summary: Paste or drop standard markdown and explore it offline: a tab per file, a collapsible section tree from GitHub-style heading slugs, in-tab and cross-tab links that flag missing targets, backlinks, inline #tags with a tag view, and Ctrl/Cmd+K fuzzy search across tab titles, headings, tags and text. Pasted HTML shows as text and only http, https, mailto and in-app links are live. One self-contained file with marked inlined; tabs are kept in this browser's storage.
